ambiguities: High-speed item (RFQ line 2): only 12 of 20 nos in 5 weeks, balance 8 nos in 11 weeks — need-by 2026-11-18 may not be met for the balance.
Lead time basis is not stated against the 5-week lead times; only the price basis is FOR Chakan, so whether 5 weeks is to delivery or ex-works needs confirmation.
Payment term '45 days net' does not state the start event (invoice date vs GRN), while the RFQ asked for days from invoice date.
Prices are exclusive of GST @18% — confirm landed comparison basis.
ISO 15243 test certificate SBT/QC/15243/2026-118 names no issuing body; confirm whether it is an in-house or third-party report.
Description for SBT-7014-HS does not mention housing, though note C18 states housing is included in all assemblies — confirm scope.
